title: Flappy Bird
description: An early game-development learning project: a Flappy Bird recreation built while learning Unity through a free Udemy course.
why: I got access to a free Unity course on Udemy and used it as an opportunity to start learning game development. This Flappy Bird recreation was one of the projects I built while following the course and experimenting with Unity.
built: A playable Flappy Bird-style game for Android with the familiar bird, pipe obstacles, and an on-screen score. Since this was an early learning project, the goal was to practice the Unity workflow rather than create a completely original game.
process: I learned by following the course, rebuilding the project in Unity, and using C# while getting familiar with how a small game is put together. I no longer remember every implementation detail, so this archive focuses on the parts I can document accurately.
learned: This was one of my early experiences with Unity and C#. It helped me become familiar with the basic workflow of building a game and turning lessons from a course into something playable.

title: 2D Platformer
description: A Windows 2D platformer learning project focused on building a game scene from free visual assets.
why: I built this project as another step in learning game development, this time focusing more on working with free assets and putting them together into a 2D platformer environment.
built: A Windows 2D platformer scene assembled from free game assets. The project gave me room to experiment with how characters, platforms, backgrounds, and environmental elements can work together visually.
process: I explored free assets and practiced arranging them into a more cohesive game environment. The engine and programming-language details are not included here because I do not remember them clearly enough to document them accurately.
learned: This project gave me experience working with existing game assets and showed me how separate visual elements can be combined into a more complete game scene.
